dedupe_keys.name: les carrefours de signalisation lumineuse tricolore a argenteuil

description: Les carrefours de signalisation lumineuse tricolore à Argenteuil is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville d'Argenteuil. Les voies et carrefours nécessitant la gestion du trafic et la sécurisation des passages piétons par l'installation permanente de signalisation lumineuse tricolore,sur la commune d'Argenteuil. Dernière mise à jour: Octobre 2020 Base: ORTHO PHOTO Aerodata 2018, 10 cm. Numérisation au 1/500. Coverage: Ville d'Argenteuil. The publisher named on the listing is Ville d'Argenteuil. Its keywords include voirie, carrefour, geospatial, circulation. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV, KML, WEB PAGE, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2020-10-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
